title: Understanding the Model Equation
text: The model equation is $$self_{rating}=\theta_0+\theta_1 critic_1$$. This equation predicts $$self_{rating}$$ based on $$critic_{1's}$$ rating.

title: Effect of Subtracting the Median
text: Subtracting the median from $$critic_1$$ will shift all values of $$critic_1$$ by a constant. Consider how this affects the slope $$\theta_1$$ in the equation.

title: Impact on $$\theta_1$$
text: The slope $$\theta_1$$ represents the change in $$self_{rating}$$ for a unit change in $$critic_1$$. Shifting $$critic_1$$ by a constant does not change the slope.
